subject: ThriveWell identity/compliance intake — SSO, SCIM & evidence next steps
body:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Thompson <evelyn@thrivewellhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: ThriveWell identity/compliance intake — SSO, SCIM & evidence next steps

Hi Evelyn — thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we can get your security team what they need.

Summary from the call:
- ThriveWell is evaluating Redwood for patient-facing documentation generation and internal summarization features (PII/HIPAA implications flagged).
- Primary concerns: SOC 2 attestation window, data residency/GDPR controls for EU patients, and strong identity/access controls (SSO, SCIM provisioning, RBAC for clinical vs. admin workflows).
- Current ask from your security team: a completed vendor security questionnaire + artifacts demonstrating SSO/SAML configuration, SCIM provisioning shape, and admin audit controls.

What we will provide this week:
1) SOC 2 snapshot (redwood-soc2-snapshot-2025.pdf) — latest available report + scope note.
2) SSO/SCIM technical note and architecture diagram (attachment: sso-scim-diagram.png) showing supported bindings, IdP metadata example, and SCIM endpoints.
3) Sample RBAC matrix and admin audit log export example.
4) Completed vendor security questionnaire (attached as XLSX) with short clarifications in-line.

Open items for ThriveWell (please confirm):
- Preferred identity provider (Okta / Azure AD / other)? We can provide IdP-specific metadata snippets.
- SCIM provisioning scope: do you plan to provision groups with role attributes or just users?
- Compliance scope: is HIPAA BAA required in addition to SOC 2 evidence? If so, we can escalate to our compliance team for a BAA template.

Proposed timeline:
- Today (Fri): share artifacts above (we have draft SOC2 snapshot and questionnaire completed).
- Mon: Rishi to follow up with the SCIM API sample and a short runbook for onboarding (30–45 min tech call if helpful).
- Tue/Wed: ThriveWell security review and list of any clarifying questions.

If that works, I’ll send the attachments now and loop in Rishi for the technical follow-up.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

[Attachment: vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet, 72KB)]
[Attachment: redwood-soc2-snapshot-2025.pdf (pdf, 420KB)]
[Attachment: sso-scim-diagram.png (image, 180KB)]

-----Original Message-----
From: Evelyn Thompson <evelyn@thrivewellhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Brandon Lee <brandon.lee@thrivewellhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 10:34:12 -0400
Subject: Re: ThriveWell identity/compliance intake — SSO, SCIM & evidence next steps

Thanks Soojin — appreciate the clear recap. Two quick notes:
1) We use Okta (org: thrivewell.okta.com). Okta + SCIM with group-level attributes is our preferred flow.
2) Yes — HIPAA BAA will be required for any PHI processing. Please include a BAA template or routing to legal.

Also attaching our vendor security questionnaire (VSA). I populated some fields but left tech sections blank — our security engineer will need the SAML metadata and SCIM endpoint examples to complete.

Best,
Evelyn
Director of IT Security | ThriveWell Health
evelyn@thrivewellhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-4410

[Attachment: ThriveWell_VSA_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 68KB)]

On Mon, Oct 5, 2026 at 11:20 AM Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Evelyn — got your note and the VSA, thanks. Circling Rishi in for the technical deliverables.
> 
> Rishi — ThriveWell is on Okta and wants SCIM provisioning with group-level roles. They flagged HIPAA/BAA as required. Can you: 1) share the SCIM endpoint examples and sample payloads, 2) confirm SAML bindings we support for Okta, and 3) provide a short admin-audit export example?
> 
> I put a tentative 30-minute slot on Tue for a tech sync (feel free to decline if you prefer a written handoff).
> 
> Thanks —
> Soojin
> 
> -----Original Message-----
> From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
> To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Thompson <evelyn@thrivewellhealth.com>
> Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
> Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 08:52:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: ThriveWell identity/compliance intake — SSO, SCIM & evidence next steps
> 
> Hi all — taking point on the technical deliverables. Quick status: attaching a short README with SCIM examples and an Okta metadata snippet. The SCIM endpoints are standard (POST /scim/v2/Users, PUT /scim/v2/Users/{id}, PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id}, GET /scim/v2/Groups) and support a custom role attribute (urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:redwood:2.0:Role).
> 
> Included attachments in this thread:
> - sso-scim-diagram.png (architecture)
> - scim-samples.md (text file with payload examples)
> - okta-metadata.xml (IdP metadata snippet)
> - admin-audit-sample.csv (sample audit rows)
> 
> Notes / clarifications:
> - For RBAC: we recommend provisioning a group per high-level role (clinician, reviewer, admin). Role attribute allows mapping to finer-grained permissions within Redwood.
> - Audit logs: exports include ISO timestamps, user_id, action, client_ip; we can provide a longer retention option under Dedicated plans if you need >90 days.
> - SOC 2: the snapshot we provided covers our production inference and storage subsystems; for HIPAA-specific controls we can share a BAA and additional policy excerpts after legal review.
> 
> Ask to ThriveWell: can you confirm a target date for user provisioning cutover? If you want, we can do a sandbox provisioning run and share a short log of delta changes.
> 
> Thanks —
> Rishi Malhotra
> Staff Engineering, Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
> rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
> 
> [Attachment: scim-samples.md (text, 8KB)]
> [Attachment: okta-metadata.xml (xml, 4KB)]
> [Attachment: admin-audit-sample.csv (csv, 12KB)]

On Tue, Oct 6, 2026 at 09:08 AM Evelyn Thompson <evelyn@thrivewellhealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks Rishi — this is exactly what we needed. We’ll review the SCIM samples and confirm a provisioning cutover window.
> 
> Quick question: can you confirm whether Redwood’s SCIM implementation supports provisioning custom attributes for group membership (we need to map to EMR privileges)?
> 
> Also routing the HIPAA/BAA request to our procurement — they’ll expect a BAA template and any indemnity clarifications.
> 
> I’ll aim to get you back by EOD Wed with a list of any follow-ups.
> 
> Best,
> Evelyn
> 
> [End of thread]
